description: Local and trade news about Texas data center and large load projects near an address or coordinate or in a county: headline, outlet, date and link, located to the project site, town or county, tagged by topic (abatement, zoning, opposition, water, power, jobs, construction, cancellation, moratorium, lawsuit). Pro adds a short summary of each story and the linked projects. Use when someone asks what is being reported about data centers near a site or in a county, or wants the local story behind a project.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: With an address or lat/lng. Default 25, max 100.

since_days.description: Only stories from the last N days. Default 730.

name: data_center_news
title: Local news on Texas data center projects
